name: The Kindergarten Manager
source:
He is the owner of Yuen Kong Kindergarten in Kowloon Tong.
As a result of the news coverage of the attack on Francis and the death of Shrewd Lou, it became widely known that the son of an underworld organization member was attending the kindergarten, and a number of students moved to other kindergarten.
With his business in jeopardy, he consulted Big B about closing the kindergarten and putting the property up for sale.
Big B introduces him to Shawn, who struggles with Yvet's request to keep the kindergarten going.
